description: This file defines an abstract base class for integer-valued discrete probability distributions, providing default implementations for some common methods such as cumulative probability, inverse cumulative probability, sampling, and supporting utilities. It serves as a foundational component in the Apache Commons Math library for distributions.

classes.name: AbstractIntegerDistribution
classes.description: An abstract base class for integer-valued discrete distributions, providing default implementations for core methods like cumulative probability, inverse cumulative probability, and sampling, enabling subclasses to define specific distributions.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates P(x0 < X <= x1) using cumulativeProbability at x1 and x0. Throws an exception if x1 < x0.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the inverse cumulative probability (quantile) for a given probability p, using bracketing and optional Chebyshev inequalities to narrow the search range.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the distribution using inverse transform sampling.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates an array of random samples of specified size.

methods.name: reseedRandomGenerator
methods.description: Re-seeds the underlying random number generator with a specified seed.

methods.name: checkedCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Helper method to ensure cumulativeProbability does not return NaN; throws MathInternalError if it does.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of the probability mass function at a given point.
